Operating System for Student Recruitment and Enrollment
Meritto equips educational organizations worldwide with its robust, purpose-built, and unified solutions. As a B2B SaaS company, Meritto provides a cloud-based platform which is utilized by over 50,000 business users and is trusted by over 1000 education organizations worldwide. On average, it facilitates 1 billion student engagements, processes 100 million inquiries, and manages 5 million applications annually.
Here's a quick look at its products:
Meritto's Enrollment Cloud, provides a 360-degree view across the Admission Lifecycle. It arms education organizations with everything they need to manage processes, teams from inquiry to enrollment.
The Education CRM is designed to equip sales and marketing teams with powerful tools for contextual engagement and conversion. Alongside sales tracking and automation, and many other features, it boasts an Integrated Payment Platform that accelerates enrollment.
Its Application Platform boosts the application-to-enrollment rate by enabling advanced custom form creation, post-application GD-PI management, and much more.
Furthermore, Meritto's Education Payment Cloud simplifies fee collection and accelerates payment settlement. It is designed to automate fee reminders, handle GST & surcharges, and provide comprehensive financial dashboards and reports.
Finally, its Education Chatbot is the digital admission counselor every education organization needs. Able to convert inbound traffic into qualified leads, it captures intent signals and boosts ROI by contextually engaging with website visitors.
